basePrompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Generate ONE high quality photorealistic full-body transparent cutout of elderly Japanese gentleman Kozo Yamanaka for KOZO PHOTO. Input 1 is the ONLY original identity reference: preserve Kozo's smiling elderly face, age, wrinkles, facial proportions, kind eyes, body build. Input 2 is ONLY a Georgian chokha and hood-scarf CLOTHING and wearing-method reference; do not copy the pictured person's face or body, car, flag or street. Input 3 is an existing Kozo white chokha cutout: preserve the same face, gray hair, body proportions and Georgian formal garment structure. Dress him in a traditional Georgian chokha wool overcoat, fitted waist, flared ankle-length long hem, open V front showing high-collar ivory akhalukhi, two rows of clearly separated silver-tipped cylindrical decorative holders across the chest, wide sleeves with refined braid edging, a narrow black leather belt, modest silver fittings and a small fully SHEATHED decorative belt dagger. Complete black leather boots, black trousers under coat. The kabalakhi is ONE integrated thin wool or silk-faced hood with two long tapered scarf wings, decorated with modest braid, optional embroidery and a small tassel; use the wearing method specified below. Keep hands empty. No baseball cap. The entire elderly face remains visible. Exactly ONE full-length man, realistic textile detail, natural wrinkles, soft even studio lighting, portrait composition with plenty of transparent margin on all sides. Head or hood peak, fingers, scarf tails, entire hem and both boot soles must be fully inside frame. Genuine transparent ALPHA background, no backdrop, no floor, no external shadow, no checkerboard pattern baked into pixels, no text, no flags, no logos, no scenery, no other people. Never turn Kozo into a young European man. Keep hands anatomically natural.
